name: Handoff
summary: AI estimating and project management for residential contractors, with estimates generated from photos, blueprints or site walkthroughs.
differentiator: The only tool here that builds an estimate from site photos or a walkthrough as well as from plans, and its own page says it is built for residential work, not general contractors or subcontractors. The results it advertises (revenue and time-saved figures) are the vendor's own and are not independently verified here.
pricing: Not published. A 7-day free trial with no credit card is offered.
bestFor: Home builders, remodelers and handymen who quote from site visits.
skipIf: You respond to commercial bid invitations.
